messages:
maya: Heads-up — need to sync on onboarding APAC-SEA region to AWS Marketplace + partner quota approvals. Partner is CloudWave.
liam: Do we have capacity numbers from infra? how many reserved GPUs needed?
sanjay: We can commit up to 16 A100s in ap-southeast-3 initially, burst to 32. Need quota request to partner + marketplace listing approved.
rachel: CloudWave rep is asking for timelines for go‑live, they want a 3 week window.
maya: Targeting 2026-04-15 for soft launch. Will require marketplace listing, KYC, and quota approval. I'll share the spreadsheet.
maya: Spreadsheet: https://redwood.app/partner/onboarding/cloudwave-apac-quotas (placeholder)
liam: For marketplace we need AMI/container images for AWS/GCP. Do we have AMI build? sanjay?
sanjay: Container images ready (gcr + ecr), AMI still WIP. I can have AMI by next Tue. Also need to register entitlement plan for reserved capacity.
owen: Legal: we'll need partner AUP + DPIA sign off. Send draft contract to legal@redwood.com. ETA 3 business days.
partner-aws-rep: AWS side: I'll file the quota case for ap-southeast-3; need exact resource codes and justification. Please send numbers and expected qps.
rachel: Expected steady-state qps 800 req/s, peak 2k req/s. Token throughput ~ 1.2M tokens/day. Requesting 20 A100-equivalent GPU hours reserved.
liam: Can we quantify as 20 A100s reserved or 10 A100 + 30 T4s? Prefer A100 for low-latency.
sanjay: Prefer mix: 12 A100 + 16 H100 fallback. We'll confirm exact SKU counts.
maya: Action items: Maya -> finalize partner packet + send to partner-aws-rep by EOD. Sanjay -> finalize AMI + quota sheet by Tue. Owen -> review contract. Liam -> finalize marketplace packaging checklist. Rachel -> confirm sales SKUs and pricing. :thumbsup:
k8s-bot: deploy notification: built images pushed to ecr://redwood/partners/cloudwave-apac:20260318-09
liam: Also need marketplace listing approvals: AWS may take 5-7 business days once submitted. Plan accordingly.
partner-aws-rep: I'll expedite quota ticket but need that doc ASAP.
maya: One more thing — support routing: ensure dedicated capacity routing in region and fallback to us-west-3 if capacity hit. Sanjay can you add routing policy?
sanjay: Yes I'll add policy: prefer ap-southeast-3, fallback to us-west-3, with graceful degradation and canary at 10%.
rachel: Let's set an internal go/no-go review 2 days before soft launch. I'll book a 30-min sync.
maya: Thanks everyone. I'll post the invitation + attach spreadsheet. Ping me if anything blocks. :pray:
